story:
I'm Samuel Godonu, a Chemical Engineering student at Lagos State University, focused on energy, oil and gas, and chemical processes.

My hands-on work so far is in process simulation with Aspen Plus: building flowsheets with recycle and purge loops, running sensitivity studies, and reading the energy requirements that come out. I document the assumptions and limits of every model, because a simulation is only useful if you know what it does not prove.

Beyond the classroom I run a creative design practice (P.kreatif Designs, since 2020), co-founded The Builders Circle, and serve in student communities for engineers. I'm eager to learn from and collaborate with peers and professionals in chemical engineering.
